attributes.name: Blessing of Mammon
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 2 dice to any check; after the check, if this card has the Corrupted trait, a random character at your location is dealt Fire damage equal to the lowest die of the size you added.

Discard this card to explore your location.

After you play this card, if the top card of the blessings discard pile has the Corrupted trait, recharge this card instead of discarding it.
